name: Echoes: The Lies We Tell Ourselves
source:
It's a character-driven story about MC, a young film student trying to escape a painful past by starting over at Oakheart University. To survive, he wears a mask—that of a charming, witty, and outgoing guy. But behind the scenes, he's just a quiet, observant director, terrified of letting anyone see the real him.

As MC, you'll navigate this new life and build relationships with six very different young women, each struggling with their own secrets and the lies they whisper to themselves. Your choices will determine if you can break through their walls—and your own—to find a genuine connection.

[From [url=https://oldcatlyk4n.itch.io/echoes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于MC的角色驱动故事，MC是一位年轻的电影系学生，试图通过在奥克哈特大学重新开始来逃避痛苦的过去。为了生存，他戴着面具——一个迷人、机智、外向的人。但在幕后，他只是一个安静、善于观察的导演，害怕让任何人看到真实的他。

作为主持人，你将驾驭这种新生活，并与六位截然不同的年轻女性建立关系，她们每个人都在为自己的秘密和自言自语的谎言而苦苦挣扎。你的选择将决定你是否能够突破他们以及你自己的围墙，找到真正的联系。

[来自[url=https://oldcatlyk4n.itch.io/echoes]Itch.io[/url]]
